topic_title: Driving is a Privilege — Risk, Responsibilities & Consequences
prompt: A school bus is stopped with red flashing lights and stop arm extended on a highway divided by an unpaved median barrier. Must opposing traffic on the other side stop?

options.text: No, traffic on the opposite roadway separated by a median may proceed
Yes, all vehicles in both directions must stop until the bus moves
Yes, but only if children are actively crossing the opposing traffic
No, but opposing drivers must honk their horn before passing by

svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 420 180" class="w-full max-h-48 rounded-xl bg-[#1C201D]">
            <!-- Divided Highway: Northbound lanes, Median, Southbound lanes -->
            <rect x="0" y="15" width="420" height="55" fill="#242825" />
            <!-- Physical Raised Grassy Median -->
            <rect x="0" y="70" width="420" height="40" fill="#15803D" />
            <text x="160" y="94" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="'JetBrains Mono', monospace" font-size="9" font-weight="bold">PHYSICAL MEDIAN</text>
            <rect x="0" y="110" width="420" height="55" fill="#242825" />

            <!-- Yellow School Bus stopped in Northbound lane -->
            <g transform="translate(180, 24)">
              <rect x="0" y="0" width="70" height="34" rx="4" fill="#FACC15" stroke="#18181B" stroke-width="2" />
              <text x="8" y="21" fill="#18181B" font-family="'JetBrains Mono', monospace" font-size="10" font-weight="bold">SCHOOL BUS</text>
              <!-- Stop Arm Extended -->
              <polygon points="-12,8 0,4 0,16 -12,12" fill="#DC2626" />
              <circle cx="35" cy="4" r="3" fill="#EF4444" />
              <circle cx="45" cy="4" r="3" fill="#EF4444" />
            </g>

            <!-- Following Traffic Stopped Behind Bus -->
            <g transform="translate(80, 28)">
              <rect x="0" y="0" width="44" height="26" rx="4" fill="#DC2626" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" />
              <text x="6" y="17" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="'JetBrains Mono', monospace" font-size="8" font-weight="bold">STOPPED</text>
            </g>

            <!-- Opposing Traffic across median (May Proceed) -->
            <g transform="translate(180, 124)">
              <rect x="0" y="0" width="54" height="26" rx="4" fill="#16A34A" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2" />
              <text x="4" y="17" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="'JetBrains Mono', monospace" font-size="8" font-weight="bold">PROCEED OK</text>
            </g>
          </svg>
